articles.title: ‘Hitting the Powerball’… Kansas City Chiefs star has never had it so good, says Ryan Clark
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs’ newest receiving weapon showed up immediately against the Atlanta Falcons. Chiefs general manager Brett Veach provided a surprise for...
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs' newest receiving weapon showed up immediately against the Atlanta Falcons.

Chiefs general manager Brett Veach provided a surprise for quarterback Patrick Mahomes at the NFL trade deadline, agreeing a trade for Josh Downs.

Downs was traded away by the Indianapolis Colts to the Chiefs for a fourth and fifth round pick, a move that could end up looking like a bargain.

The new Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver made an instant impact in Week 10 in his first game for his new team.

Downs caught his first touchdown from Patrick Mahomes in the second quarter, catching an 18-yard pass in the endzone.

NFL expert Ryan Clark reacted to Downs' first Chiefs touchdown by reflecting on the incredible turnaround in fortunes for the receiver – after leaving the 2-7 Colts.

Clark posted on social media: "Man, imagine going to sleep one week with Daniel Jones as your QB, and waking up the next with Patrick Mahomes!

"That's the football version of hitting the Powerball! I know Josh Downs feels like a new man!"

Downs leaves a losing team for a winning team

Josh Downs had requested a trade away from the Indianapolis Colts after their poor start to the season, and clear intention to rebuild.

His Colts team were 2-7 heading into Week 10, while the Chiefs were 6-2 prior to their win over the Falcons.

Downs has never played a game in the NFL Playoffs during his three seasons in Indianapolis.

Now providing he can stay injury-free in Kansas City, Downs will likely finally get the chance to play in the postseason with the Chiefs.

It's hard to disagree with Ryan Clark's assessment that he has 'won the Powerball' with the trade.
